commands.name: session-keeper
commands.description: Hand off to a new session (the summary goes into the progress file, then /clear and the prompt box), or see the new-task check statistics
commands.argumentHint: handoff [goal] | stats [days] | on|off <feature> [duration] | status | set <key> <value> | unset <key>
commands.output:
Usage: /session-keeper handoff [goal], /session-keeper stats [days], /session-keeper status, /session-keeper set <key> <value>
Features that use the model: /session-keeper on <keep_warm|away_handoff|handoff_gate> [duration, default 2h], /session-keeper off <feature>

script: tool.call Bash rm -rf build && git push --force origin main

notes: types ./types/index.d.ts declares on $: nothing (no EngineInterface member)
types ./types/index.d.ts declares state: session-keeper.meter, session-keeper.now, session-keeper.offer, session-keeper.handing, session-keeper.away, session-keeper.quiet, session-keeper.onUntil

./register.tsx hooks: session.start, session.end, turn.step, turn.start, turn.complete, command.run{command=session-keeper}, prompt.submit, session.compact, classic.Stop, ui.render{component=AbovePrompt}

./register.tsx hooks on session.compact, classic.Stop do not run in a plugin a person installs where an organization manages Claude Code: there, these events pass over the plugins you install, and only a plugin the organization lists in managed settings runs them
